{{Quote|Empty your magazine, fall back, reload, and do it again. When you've retreated back as far as station 3-7, sprint for the evacuation area and find transport. And hope that none of those mechanical monsters arbitrarily decides to pick on you in the process.|Colonel Ledick Firest's orders during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="GG3 2nd" />}}
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Ledick Firest''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Field Commander/Legends|field commander]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Rebel Alliance Army]] whose men survived more battles than any other group during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Firest was stationed at the Rebellion's secret [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]] of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he was responsible for carrying out the orders of base commanders [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] to [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] in the field. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Firest used to a maximum the previous combat experience he gained while training as a field commander with the [[Laramus Base Irregulars]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group to help direct the Rebels' [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|defensive evacuation strategy]] against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invasion [[Blizzard Force/Legends|force]] in order to buy enough [[Time/Legends|time]] for Echo Base's evacuation [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to escape Hoth.

Firest was left with only five [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and two [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] of [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] to meet an overpowering force of Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Knowing that the Empire's primary target during the battle would be Echo Base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] to neutralize the Rebels' [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] protecting the base from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], Firest organized his [[Ground Defense Forces|defensive forces]] in such a way that funneled the AT-ATs toward the power generators, effectively giving the Empire what it wanted while surreptitiously leading the Imperials away from the base's highly vulnerable evacuation staging area, where the transports were lifting off. Although the Rebels suffered heavy casualties during the Battle of Hoth, Firest's efforts helped many of Echo Base's personnel, including the Alliance High Command, escape the planet. Firest himself survived the battle and escaped aboard the last evacuation transport, the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']].

==Biography==
===Battle of Hoth defensive strategy===
{{Quote|I say again. Code Red Alert! Imperial Walkers sighted on north ridge, 2 klicks from Echo! General Rieekan!"''<br />''"I copy, Colonel. Initiate Evac Rearguard Action 101. You have five companies defense troops, a couple of flights of Speeders at your disposal&mdash;followed by whatever else we can scrape together."''<br />''"Roger that. Five companies, two flights. That's not much to hold off an Assault Group&hellip;"''<br />''"That's all we have, Colonel Firest&hellip;and Ledick&mdash;it's all or nothing this time.|Colonel Ledick Firest and General Carlist Rieekan|<ref name="Assault on Hoth">''[[Assault on Hoth]]''</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ESB" /> Ledick Firest served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Rebel Alliance Army]] during the early course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Firest's previous combat experience, acquired while training as a [[Field Commander/Legends|field commander]] with the [[Laramus Base Irregulars]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group, would prove invaluable to him during one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] most trying campaigns of the war.<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Firest was stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He was chiefly responsible for executing Echo Base's [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troop]] movements in the field, as directed by base commanders [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the existence of the base by way of a remote-reconnaissance [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]]<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Rebellion prepared for the imminent Imperial invasion, and the responsibility fell to Firest to carry out Rieekan's preplanned defensive evacuation strategy, [[Evac Rearguard Action 101]].<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

[[File:Firest-AFA.jpg|thumb|left|275px|On Hoth, Ledick Firest was responsible for carrying out Rebel troop movements in the field, as ordered by the Echo Base command staff.]]
Rieekan ordered a full evacuation of Echo Base, leaving only five [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and two [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] under Firest's command to defend the Alliance's retreat against the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Imperial invasion force]]. Both Rieekan and Firest knew immediately that the base's [[Ground Defense Forces]]defensive forces could never hope to stop the Imperial advance. Rather, Rieekan's orders were simply to delay the Imperial forces long enough to allow all of Echo Base's evacuation [[Transport/Legends|transports]] [[Time/Legends|time]] to escape Hoth. But Firest also realized that his forces would not be able to hold the base's perimeter for long. If he could not stop the Imperial invasion, Firest instead hoped to manipulate it. He suspected that the Empire's primary target would be the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], in order to bring down the powerful [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] protecting Echo Base from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. So, Firest planned to let the Empire have the generators as it wanted, organizing his defenses to make it seem like the Rebels were chiefly concerned with defending the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] and not the highly vulnerable evacuation staging area on the far side of the base, where the Rebels' transports would be lifting off.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

To keep the Imperial invasion force's advancing [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] away from the departing transports, Firest's men created a lightly defended corridor leading straight to the power generators, while placing heavy [[Artillery/Legends|gun emplacements]] to the side, which would effectively funnel the Imperial forces down the path Firest wanted them to take. At the same time, Firest knew the Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that had discovered Echo Base had most likely relayed the base's defensive formations back to the invasion force, so Firest had to create the impression that his defenses were just as the probe had reported, when in reality they were only slightly different to lead the AT-ATs away from the transports. Firest's defenses would keep the advancing AT-ATs clustered together in a relatively tight grouping, which was imperative for the base's snowspeeders, the most vital element of the Rebels' defensive strategy, to have any effect.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

Firest ordered the men under his command, combat veterans and green recruits alike, to continually empty their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and fall back, until they reached [[Station 3-7|Echo Station 3-7]], where they would then sprint for transport at the evacuation staging area and hopefully escape before the AT-ATs brought them down.<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> But he also issued the caveat for his men to avoid frontal engagement with the walkers, which would bring the full might of the AT-ATs' blasters to bear on them. Instead, he instructed them to outmaneuver the walkers and get in behind them.<ref name="Assault on Hoth" /> Still, Firest knew his orders would mean the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many of the Rebellion's finest soldiers.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

===Successful evacuation===
{{Quote|Come on!|Colonel Ledick Firest orders his men to storm the downed AT-AT walker Blizzard 2|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Pornostache.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Ledick Firest fights during the Battle of Hoth.]]
Firest worked alongside his men, helping to set up equipment in and around Echo Base's defensive ice trenches in preparation for the upcoming engagement.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="Technical Journal">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Rebel Forces]]''</ref> While the Rebel defenders waited for the onset of battle, Firest used [[Model TD2.3 electrobinoculars/Legends|Model TD2.3 electrobinoculars]]<ref name="Action Figure Archive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> to scan the horizon for signs of the approaching enemy.<ref name="Action Figure Archive" /> When the first call came from [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]] on Echo Base's external defensive perimeter announcing the presence of Imperial AT-AT walkers only two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from Hoth's [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]],<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> Firest, to his shock, sighted the immense walkers heading straight for the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generators.<ref name="Action Figure Archive" /> He then announced the formal [[Code Red Alert]] to the base by way of communication with Rieekan,<ref name="Assault on Hoth" /> which first initiated the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> As Rieekan emphasized the dire need for the Rebels to evacuate quickly while still under the protection of the base's deflector shield, Firest responded that he would not let Rieekan and the rest of Echo Base down.<ref name="Assault on Hoth" />

Firest monitored the battle from his entrenched position through his [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]].<ref name="ESB" /> As the fighting raged, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] downed the AT-AT [[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]] using his snowspeeder's [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]] to trip the walker's legs, the first AT-AT neutralized during the battle.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Upon seeing the walker fall, Firest immediately signaled his men to storm the downed machine. However, as two of Firest's soldiers,<ref name="ESB" /> [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Vildar Blin]] and an [[Vildar Blin's assistant|assistant]],<ref name="Who's Who in Echo Base">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> charged forward,<ref name="ESB" /> a snowspeeder [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] fired on the crippled AT-AT from overheard, destroying it. The two men were killed in the resulting massive explosion.<ref name="Who's Who in Echo Base" /> At some point during the battle, Firest manned a [[Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon]] with great ferocity.<ref name="TCG-Core">{{FFGTCG|set=Star Wars: The Card Game Core Set|cardname=Heavy Blaster Emplacement|link=core/heavy-blaster-emplacement-core-9-5}}</ref>

The Battle of Hoth proved to be the Rebel Alliance's worst ground defeat of the Galactic Civil War. The Rebellion suffered heavy casualties and the loss of Echo Base,<ref name="CSWE-Battle of Hoth">{{CSWECite|II|62|Hoth, Battle of}}</ref> but Firest's defensive strategy worked. By clustering his forces together and unleashing maximum concentrated firepower on the advancing AT-AT line, Firest prevented the walkers from deviating toward the evacuation staging area and held off the Imperial invasion from destroying the power generators long enough for many of the base's transports and personnel, including the Alliance High Command, to safely evacuate.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

While the Rebellion lost many&mdash;only one of the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] in Firest's five companies, [[Reyé Hollis/Legends|Reyé Hollis]], survived<ref name="Who's Who in Echo Base" />&mdash;the casualties would have been much higher if not for Firest's efforts. Firest himself survived the battle and escaped Hoth aboard the final evacuation transport,<ref name="GG3 2nd" /> the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']].<ref name="CSWE-Battle of Hoth" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Look. Those Walkers' blasters are murder. You can't go toe-to-toe with 'em. You gotta outmaneuver 'em&mdash;get in behind. 'Cause if they get a decent shot off, you've had it.|Colonel Ledick Firest, commanding Echo Base's ground defenses|<ref name="Assault on Hoth" />}}
[[File:SWL-MarkII-Blaster-Trooper.png|thumb|right|250px|During the Battle of Hoth, Firest used to great effect the harsh combat experience he gained previously while training with mercenaries.]]
Colonel Ledick Firest was known for the development of his subordinate [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and commanders serving under him while with the Rebellion. His group survived more battles than any other group during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="CSWE-Ledick Firest">{{CSWECite|I|275|Firest, Colonel Ledick}}</ref> Firest used his experience while training as a field commander with the Laramus Base Irregulars to a maximum during the Rebellion's evacuation at the Battle of Hoth. His instructions to the men serving under his command at Hoth&mdash;to keep emptying and reloading their blasters until they had fallen back far enough to retreat, all the while hoping none of the AT-AT walkers decided to target them in the process&mdash;were terrifying simple, according to Rebel Alliance [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]. Firest owed his ability to give such orders to his harsh combat experience and military training, though he nonetheless appreciated their full consequence&mdash;that those same orders would mean the deaths of many of his best and brightest soldiers.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

Firest had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="Starships & Vehicles 10" /> blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. He sported a large mustache that grew down both sides of his chin. By the start of the Hoth battle, Firest had a healed scar just below his right eye.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Hoth, Firest wore the standard [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather armor]] of Echo Base's field troops.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="Technical Journal" /> His [[Armor/Legends|outfit]] included the set's [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]], [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]], [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|padded vest]], [[thermal flak jacket]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|gloves]],<ref name="Action Figure Archive" /> [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|belt]],<ref name="TCG-Core" /> [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|leggings]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|boots]],<ref name="Technical Journal" /> and [[Alliance Cold Weather Backpack/Legends|backpack]].<ref name="Action Figure Archive" /> Firest's equipment also included an [[A295 blaster rifle/Legends|A295 blaster rifle]],<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Rebel Commander|link=VINtRebelcomm.asp}}</ref> a standard-issue [[DL-21 blaster pistol/Legends|DL-21 blaster pistol]] sidearm, which he wore [[Holster/Legends|holstered]] at his right hip,<ref name="Technical Journal" /> Model TD2.3 electrobinoculars, and a pair of smaller [[Binoculars/Legends|binoculars]].<ref name="Action Figure Archive" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
The character Colonel Ledick Firest first appeared in a set of brief quotation narratives in the rule book supplement of the [[1988]] [[West End Games]] board game ''[[Assault on Hoth]]'', in which he is identified as the field officer in command of the Echo Base defensive forces during the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Assault on Hoth" /> Firest later received mention in the first edition of the [[1989]] West End Games sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', written by [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="GG3 1st">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The Firest character was again mentioned in the [[1996]] [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|second edition]] of ''Galaxy Guide 3'', as part of a major expansion on the sourcebook by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], in which Firest was provided greater biographical details concerning his performance during the battle and full [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] statistics for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG3 2nd" />

In [[2013]], the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 5 (2013)|fifth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s relaunched [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2013)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'']] serial publication,<ref name="Fact File 5">{{FactFile2013|5|HOT 1-6|The Battle of Hoth}}</ref> written by [[Iain Lowson]],<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> established Firest to be a mustachioed Rebel trench officer appearing in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Fact File 5" /> The trench officer appears fleetingly during the Battle of Hoth following the downing of the first Imperial walker, shouting "Come on!" to his [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="ESB" /> [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]], published just prior to the film and which includes a version of this scene, is therefore now [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] considered to be the Firest character's first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>

According to author [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] in his book ''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]'', the mustachioed [https://www.rebelscum.com/VINtRebelcomm.asp "Rebel Commander"] action figure from [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] original 1980 [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]] is based on Ledick Firest.<ref name="Action Figure Archive" /> Note, however, that the figure's packaging features an image of Echo Base Rebel [[Jeroen Webb]].<ref name="Kenner" /> In that toy line's assembly instructions for the [[1981]] Imperial Cruiser figure, the figure was depicted as a captive in the cruiser's rear compartment.<ref name="cruiser">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Imperial Cruiser|altlink=http://theswca.com/images-toys/figuretoys/impcruiser.html}}</ref> [[1982|One year later]], the toy line released the [[CAP-2 Captivator]] vehicle, with packaging showing [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] using the vehicle to capture Firest, delivering the Rebel to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="cap">{{KennerCite|set=Mini-Rigs|pack=CAP-2 (Captivator)|altlink=http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=39676}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies===
The earliest incarnation of the Firest character, as retroactively established by ''The Official Star Wars Fact File 5'', appears in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization,<ref name="Fact File 5" /><ref name="ESB novel" /> which includes a version of the character's scene that differs from the corresponding film scene.<ref name="ESB" /> The novel explains that, following the toppling of the Imperial walker, a Rebel officer leaps out of his snow trench and signals his men to follow him in a boisterous charge on the fallen machine before they are thrown backward in the walker's explosion.<ref name="ESB novel" /> However, the film only shows Firest as signaling his men forward and remaining in his trench to monitor the situation through his electrobinoculars while two other soldiers charge the walker.<ref name="ESB" /> Additionally, the two soldiers who charge the walker are established to have been killed in the explosion, according to the [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article [[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|''Who's Who in Echo Base'']].<ref name="Who's Who in Echo Base" /> Given the predominance of film material over all other elements of continuity,<ref name="Chee-SW.com">{{Blog|holocron|33|What'd I say again? Select posts by me regarding continuity}}</ref> this article treats ''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization as an inconsistency.

Both editions of ''Galaxy Guide 3'' include a quote said by Firest to his troops regarding what they are to do during the battle&mdash;meet the Imperial invasion, fall back, and eventually retreat to find transport to escape Hoth.<ref name="GG3 2nd" /><ref name="GG3 1st" /> However, in the [[1993]] ''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]'' by West End Games, which compiles information from ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'', ''Galaxy Guide 3'', and ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'', Firest's quote is altered from the way it appears in both ''Galaxy Guide 3'' editions: "Fight as hard as you can, fall back if you must, and take down as many of them as possible. When you've retreated back as far as station 3-7, sprint for the evacuation area and find transport. And watch your back for incoming walker fire." The original quote can be found at the top of this article.<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
